request.query: finitely supported function product equals product over a finite type if zero maps to one

items.name: Finsupp.prod_fintype
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : CommMonoid N] [inst_2 : Fintype α]
  (f : α →₀ M) (g : α → M → N), (∀ (i : α), g i 0 = 1) → f.prod g = ∏ i, g i (f i)

items.name: DFinsupp.prod_eq_prod_fintype
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {γ : Type w} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Zero (β i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → (x : β i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] [inst_4 : CommMonoid γ] (v : Π₀ (i : ι), β i)
  {f : (i : ι) → β i → γ}, (∀ (i : ι), f i 0 = 1) → v.prod f = ∏ i, f i (DFinsupp.equivFunOnFintype v i)

items.name: Finsupp.onFinset_prod
Finsupp.prod_indicator_index
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : CommMonoid N] {s : Finset α} (f : α → M)
  {h : α → M → N}, (∀ a ∈ s, h a 0 = 1) → (Finsupp.indicator s fun x x_1 => f x).prod h = ∏ x ∈ s, h x (f x)

items.name: Finsupp.prod_eq_single
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : CommMonoid N] {f : α →₀ M} (a : α)
  {g : α → M → N}, (∀ (b : α), f b ≠ 0 → b ≠ a → g b (f b) = 1) → (f a = 0 → g a 0 = 1) → f.prod g = g a (f a)
